variables.physical_definition: Free-stream (uniform) velocity along the plate, i.e., characteristic streamwise velocity far from the boundary layer.
Kinematic viscosity (dynamic viscosity divided by density), governing viscous diffusion of momentum.
Streamwise distance from the leading edge of the flat plate (characteristic length along the plate).
Wall-normal distance from the plate into the fluid (coordinate normal to the plate).
